decisions.statement: A property whose page type is `file-property` keeps its body beside the page.
A file's name is the page's name followed by the property's slug and the ending stated.
A body is read only for a key the caller asks for by name.
A caller asking for no key reads no file.
A key naming no file property is left as the ending that key states.
A file the page names that is not there is refused rather than read as holding nothing.
A body read here is answered in place of the ending stated.
A body is read as the bytes on disk before any decoding is chosen.
A body is decoded as text only where the caller asks for text.
A property held outside the commit keeps its body in a file named apart from the rest.
Such a file is named by the caller asking for it as one held that way.
A property's body may be kept in the numbered files beside the page.
The numbered files of one property are joined in the order those files are numbered.
Reading stops at the first numbered file that is not there.

definition: the body a page keeps in a file beside the page under one file property
